title: Silas and the Hollow
premise: Ivo Villalobos steals memories for coin in the Hollow, a fog-bound valley where magic cannot follow and the old gods have been silent for a century. When prayers begin to be answered again, the valley's ruling Wardens start hunting anyone touched by divinity—including Ivo, whose stolen memories turn out to contain fragments of the gods themselves. Hunted alongside a disgraced Warden's daughter and a child who hears the gods speaking, Ivo must find the Door out of a country that officially no longer exists. In the end, Ivo sacrifices their own hoarded memories to open the Door, letting the gods and the found family escape into the wider world while choosing to remain behind as the valley's new keeper of what was lost.
about_author: K. M. Dravenmoor is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing abandoned parish records in remote mountain valleys. They write fantasy about places the maps gave up on.

chapters.title: The Taste of Other People's Years
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. We meet them mid-theft, lifting a dying woman's happiest summer from her mind for a grieving buyer. The Hollow's rules are established: no magic, no gods, no leaving. Emotional beat: lonely competence masking a hunger for a life that isn't borrowed.

chapters.title: A Prayer Answered in Ash
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A client's stolen memory burns Ivo's hands—impossible in the magic-dead valley—and inside it they glimpse a god waking. That night, the first snow falls out of season. Emotional beat: dread and wonder entwined; the valley's safety is ending.

chapters.title: The Warden's Daughter
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Sefa, daughter of the High Warden, discovers her father burning 'god-touched' citizens alive in the kiln district. She flees with evidence and a burn scar. Emotional beat: shattered loyalty; justice and law split apart before our eyes.

chapters.title: What the Child Hears
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Ivo is hired to steal a mute orphan's memories and instead finds the boy, Tam, broadcasting the gods' voices into every mind he passes. Sefa catches up to Ivo mid-job; uneasy alliance forms. Emotional beat: reluctant trust over shared guilt.

chapters.title: Ledgers of the Vanished Country
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Using her father's sealed archives, Sefa learns the Hollow was erased from maps deliberately—a prison built by the old kings to starve the gods of worshipers. The Door exists. Emotional beat: fury at inherited lies; purpose kindles.

chapters.title: Winter Takes the Kiln District
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The long winter arrives early and hard; the Wardens blame the god-touched and begin mass arrests. Ivo's fence betrays them for clemency. The trio goes underground with the city's forgotten poor. Emotional beat: found family solidifying in shared danger.

chapters.title: The God Who Remembers Being Stolen
chapters.summary: Tam's POV. The god fragment inside Ivo's stolen memories speaks through Tam: the gods were never silent—the valley stole their names, and Ivo has been carrying one unknowingly. The Wardens close in. Emotional beat: identity crisis; Ivo realizes they are both thief and relic.

chapters.title: Father's Door
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Confronting her father at the Door beneath the archive, Sefa learns he has been feeding the Wardens' power to keep the gods locked out—and that opening the Door will cost a memory-hoarder everything they've kept. Emotional beat: grief for the father who chose power over her.

chapters.title: Everything I Ever Took
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, climax. At the Door, Ivo pours every stolen memory into the lock—every borrowed life, including the god's name—as Wardens storm the cavern. The Door opens; the gods pour through; Sefa holds the line so Tam can pass. Emotional beat: devastating, triumphant self-sacrifice.

chapters.title: Keeper of What Was Lost
chapters.summary: Epilogue, Ivo's POV. Memoryless but free, Ivo remains in the thawing valley with Sefa, rebuilding among those left behind, while letters arrive from Tam in a world where gods walk openly. Emotional beat: quiet peace; a new family built from choice, not theft.
